Maria R.: Morning — quick scrub: overnight ticket volume +30% vs baseline, mostly around embedding failures and a handful of billing double-charge reports. Can folks call out ownership for the embed spike and the billing macro edits? :coffee:
ops-bot: Alert: embed-proxy error rate 6.1% in the past 30m (threshold 2.0%). See monitor: https://grafana/redwood/embed-proxy/errors
Kevin L.: I can take the embed side. I see a surge of 502s from embed-proxy to model-hosts; looks like connection resets. Starting deeper logs now, will triage queue 2 first. @Maria R. any specific customers to prioritize?
Maria R.: Prioritize the enterprise customers on Dedicated (ACME corp + FinNova) — escalations in #support-escalations. Also any requests that look like billing-impacting flows get higher priority.
Nina S.: I will patch the billing macro language to call out the refund flow and add the quick escalator link. Will push to staging and post the macro diff here. Patch note: "billing_double_charge -> add steps: capture txn id, escalate to billing-runbook, offer refund link"
Oliver T.: Quick ask — can we whitelist the new macro for first-line agents only? We shouldn't expose refund wording to new agents yet.
Nina S.: Good call. I'll gate it to senior-support role. Planning to merge in 20m, then run a quick A/B on 50 tickets to confirm tone.
Kevin L.: Update: found a pattern — embed-proxy upstream connections to model-hosts sometimes hit a stale keepalive; switching to shorter keepalive and increasing master timeout for the pool. Rolling change to canary (1 host) now. Logs snippet:```[embed-proxy] conn_reset from 10.2.4.12 -> 10.2.9.3 at 03:12:45```
Maria R.: Thanks. If canary looks good in 10m, open rollout and notify here. Also add a comment to the incident doc with root-cause hunting steps.
ops-bot: Deploy started: embed-proxy keepalive patch -> canary host id h-22 (initiated by Kevin L.)
Kevin L.: Canary healthy after 8m. Error rate down to 0.9% on canary. I'll start 10% rollout and monitor token latencies.
Nina S.: Macro PR: https://git.internal/redwood/support-macros/pull/489 — added gating + wording tweak. Anyone review?
Oliver T.: Reviewing now, left one nit about phrasing for refunds.
Maria R.: Great. Plan for today: Kevin continues embed rollout + deeper logs for 1h, Nina merges macro gated to senior agents and notifies shift, Oliver to approve PR, I’ll monitor customer escalations and coordinate any outbound comms. Blockers: none new besides watching rollout.
Kevin L.: Ping if you see any regression in model tokenization errors — will keep rolling back thresholds if needed.
Nina S.: Merged and gated. Updating support playbook and sending short note to shift leads. :white_check_mark:
Maria R.: Thanks team — standdown unless anything pops. If anyone picks up remaining low-priority tickets, drop a quick status here.
